subject: shotgun
label: shotgun, in the place of the game's models/v_shotgun.mdl, models/p_shotgun.mdl, models/w_shotgun.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_crowbar.mdl, models/w_9mmar.mdl, models/w_sqknest.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, D, D, D where the asset was C, B, A, C: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The side and front views (sides.png) show one long slab with a sloped end, roughly 31 long, 21 wide and 4 thick. The brief asks for a pump shotgun, whose outline has a barrel, a receiver, a pump and an angled stock. None of those read in any of the ten views, so the silhouette is a long bar and not a shotgun's outline. The length fits the brief, which is why this is 1 and not 0.

M2.reason: Measured length 31.4 against the brief's 30 is 4.7% off, within 15%. The brief gives no width or height, so only the length is checked.

M3.reason: The brief's parts are a barrel, a pump (forend), a stock, a receiver, a trigger and trigger guard, sights and a magazine tube. None is in the asset, which is one solid block with one sloped face (sides.png, FRONT and LEFT; first-person.png). Nothing is painted in to stand for them either, so they are missing in shape and in paint.

M4.reason: The whole asset is one mid-grey, matte metal (sides.png, lineup.png A). The brief asks for black metal and a wooden or dark pump and stock. No region is black, and no region is wood-coloured, so the metal is clearly off and the wood is absent.

M5.reason: The brief names no markings, but the metal and wood it asks for imply surface detail. The asset has only a light edge highlight and one faint seam (sides.png, LEFT; first-person.png), with no receiver detail, ports or grain. Clearly off for a pump shotgun's surface.

M6.reason: The line-up measure has the judges picking the crowbar as the odd one out (D, D, D, D), so the asset passed as Valve's. Looking at the pictures, a grey wedge beside the shotgun in first-person.png is not a shotgun, and a player would not take it for the game's. The cap of 2 is not reached on sight.

M7.reason: No front can be read. The block has no muzzle, stock or top to mark one, and the wedge end is the only asymmetry (sides.png, FRONT). Whether it stands on its origin as a shotgun does cannot be checked against a shape with no parts.

M8.reason: SMAK's check returns no errors. Ten triangles is far under every band for Half-Life's weapons. The six sides and the below view (sides.png) show closed faces, with nothing open, inside out or floating.

W1.reason: In first-person.png and attack.png the asset stays in the frame and touches the orange gloves at its base, so it does not part from the hands. It sits left of the game's shotgun, which is held right, and sits at a steep diagonal rather than level. Its muzzle end is not where a shotgun's would be, so it is held differently from the game's.
